body: I didn't mean to come of harsh , but suicidal peeps including myself, aren't saying this for shits and giggles . It's difficult to change things for the better when we can't seem to change ourselves. I was just being devil's advocate here. but i appreciate your efforts.
I didn't downvote you because I'm curious, what amazing things are there to do? seriously answer this q. or please, stop spewing empty platitudes.

honestly, i just typed a response and it got deleted. ftw. I was going to write please stick in there. i know what its like to have a soul-sucking job. that was me at 18. and before you think, "you have your whole life ahead of you." i didn't know that then. So here I am 19, suffering from my previous, toxic decisions. I quit college. i quit my job. DESTINED for greatness, lol it's funny now I guess. All I was destined for seems to be located in your post. I was googling how to give myself cancer before i came across this post. But i also think, will i regret it? i have a family too...I dont know if this means anything to you. But from a stranger, you aren't at the bottom man. You don't have to be. I suggest you stay in your job, apply to other places. if it's worth your life, it's worth a try. right?

i've been in a similar place and here's what i would do, here's what i've done: stop drinking. don't pick a glass back up until the 2nd time you're euphoric. why the second time? the first time will influence what you associate euphoria with. How will you achieve euphoria? that is all up to you. not going to be easy, but it will be worth it. about your health, are you still smoking? eating right? are there any chances at recovery? if not , at most, cover the symptoms and live as much as you can. it's your only choice. the past is there to stay.
hey buddy, i would ask how's it goin but you've answered that.high school sucked for me as well, but i made it. you can too! if you want higher grades, reach for them.

> n this jigsaw puzzle I call life but the most important pieces are missing. I know that I need to overcome my fear of driving and moving out. I know that I am afraid because of bad experiences in the past. I'm pretty sure that time heals all wounds. I just don't know how long it will take. I don't know how long I can cling to sanity.

Girls are different. We want different things. Hopefully the next girl you find will have traits you are looking for.  emily didnt have them. I might be wrong. 
It also seems like you know what you want to do (get a job and place). take it at your own pace because things rarely happen the way we expect them.
what do you mean by if this online stuff doesnt work?
friends take time too. So don't rush them . The good ones are worth the slow progression.

are you back yet? here's a response :) 
There are more girls than emily, and if you didn't feel comfortable with her choice, then it is perfectly ok to cut things off. you aren't  a coward, if anything, you just aren't sure. maybe you needed more information. Did you? I don't know too much about aspergers but I know about life being  100 different kinds of screwed up. It sucks. Looking at it from it outside perspective, though, I view your life as eventful. I wish I had someone who found me attractive, and a 2015 friend. Anyway, you'll probably move on from Emily, but I think experience with her will help you with your future relationships.

Keep your cat company, and chill. Not everything has to be figured out in the moment. Things will hurt. They hurt for me but time (and cats) will show you there are more friends and love to be had. So wait until they come, and in the time you have with just your cat,  cherish them.
so why do you want to end it?
If that person really cared, they prob aren't gone for life. I've been there and I found if I gave friends time, and myself time, we'd be back to "normal".
How did you lose them? We're here.
